text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and six-month treasury bills edged down from the last sale on March 19, and auctions of 9-month and 12-month bills were cancelled, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Three-month bills slipped to 20.05 percent from 24.47 percent, and six-month bills edged down to 30.15 percent from 30.18 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill
auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 107 103
Issue date March 20, 1997 March 19, 1997
Maturity date June 20, 1997 June 18, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia (UAH)
Issue volume no limit stated 3.50 million UAH
Amount sold 135.49 million UAH 3.15 million UAH
Actual amount raised 129.04 million UAH 2.96 million UAH Average yield 20.05 percent 24.47 percent
Average price 95.24 hryvnia 94.25 hryvnia
Cut-off price 94.25 hryvnia 94.25 hryvnia
The central bank sold 1,354,920 T-bills, the bank's
statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 25.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 108 104
Issue date March 20, 1997 March 19, 1997
Maturity date September 19, 1997 September 17, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 9.80 million UAH 5.50 million UAH
Amount sold 4.19 million UAH 2.72 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.64 million UAH 2.36 million UAH
Average yield 30.15 percent 30.18 percent
Average price 86.93 hryvnia 86.92 hryvnia
Cut-off price 86.92 hryvnia 86.92 hryvnia
The central bank sold 41,915 T-bills, the bank's statement
said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 25.
Nine-month and 12-month T-bill auctions were cancelled without explanation.
